title: Make attention findings specific, deduplicated and actionable
description: Owner sees six vague attention cards: MESSAGE_BACKLOG, three indistinguishable WORKTREE_PROBLEM, ONE-DISK RECOVERABILITY and duplicate unacknowledged message count. Show human-readable problem, owning agent, branch/path, severity and actual consequence. Deduplicate the same message queue, group worktree issues by identity, distinguish normal ahead/unique commits from broken operations or unprotected work. Offer contextual quick actions when supported: owner approval/rejection with existing preview-confirm/revision/evidence checks, open exact message/thread, inspect exact worktree, request owning-agent review or retry a qualified operation. Non-owner approvals must not gain approve buttons. No generic dismiss, mass acknowledgement, automatic merge/cleanup or silent remote push. Actions must preserve drafts under refresh and report pending/error/unknown honestly. Owner 9590d8b1 (2026-10-01) authorizes bounded implementation using the committed observed desktop audit findings while TASK-console-ux-audit remains blocked and incomplete. Full-audit completion is no longer an implementation-start prerequisite; actual browser desktop/mobile visual acceptance remains required before completion. Scope: separate Waiting on you (genuine authenticated owner decision with consequence/options), Fleet handling (named responsible domain and next step), and Arbiter handling (provider starts/install activation). Do not rewrite the dashboard architecture or hide unresolved risks. QA path consent is required before assignment; existing frozen assertions, ownership and verification controls remain enforced.
acceptanceCriteria: Overview shows exact condition and responsible identity instead of repeated opaque codes
Duplicate message finding is one actionable card
Approve/reject appears only for an owner-addressed pending approval and uses current revision/evidence preview and explicit confirmation
Worktree progress is not falsely presented as a broken repository; unsafe recovery remains visible
Quick actions route to exact entities and cannot silently merge, acknowledge peers, publish or delete
Regression covers stale decision, wrong approver, duplicate findings, no available action, failure and refresh while editing

Waiting on you contains only a genuine owner-addressed decision with evidence/options/consequence; routine domain waits show Fleet handling with responsible owner/next step; arbiter-reserved execution/install work is labelled Arbiter handling.

Unavailable browser and last actual visual capture remain explicit verification dependencies; source/API/scenario evidence cannot be labelled visual PASS, and final desktop/mobile acceptance remains incomplete until real browser evidence exists.

Implementation uses existing observed desktop audit evidence without marking the audit completed; preserve dark mode, TORCH branding, owner authority, independent QA consent and exact candidate checks.
